metadata.description: Core/Content/Utility ordered inventory for session-55: catchment/braiding/spillway/aquifer terrain coupling, map-control cache architecture hardening, and protobuf validation continuity.

features.name: Shared world-map signature contract v19
features.description: World map generation signature now includes catchment/braiding/spillway/aquifer controls via GameCommon shared contract.

features.name: Server-authoritative worldgen config v23
features.description: World generation config expanded with catchment, braiding, spillway continuity, and aquifer barrier controls.

features.name: Unity world config parity for v19 controls
features.description: Client world config wrappers expose the same v19 terrain controls to keep preview generation aligned with server.

features.name: Catchment-aware river pressure
features.description: Improved river generator now blends catchment assist and braiding pressure damping for stable channels.

features.name: Spillway continuity tuned lakes
features.description: Lake generation introduces spillway continuity weighting to reduce broken outflow seams.

features.name: Aquifer barrier cave stabilization
features.description: Cave generation now applies aquifer barrier weighting to reduce cave leakage under wet riparian zones.

features.name: Terrain tuning profile v23
features.description: Data-driven terrain values for v19 controls are promoted into config/world.json and StreamingAssets.

features.name: Server map-control cache recency eviction
features.description: WorldMapControlManager tracks chunk access time and evicts oldest entries when cache budget is exceeded.

features.name: Client preview queue budget control
features.description: Unity world-map controller now deduplicates queued chunk requests and enforces queue/loaded chunk budgets.

features.name: Feature manifest loader session-55 priority
features.description: Server startup now prioritizes loading the session-55 core/content/utility manifest.

features.name: Protobuf runtime validation continuity
features.description: Proto runtime and registry validation remain mandatory in server startup and dummy probe flows.
